rights_policy.finding: Public access, official-government publication, and authority status are not treated as commercial storage, transformation, embedding, excerpt-display, or model-provider-transmission permission. Each publisher and content class requires source-specific rights evidence.
rights_policy.required_next_step: Obtain and record source-specific reuse permission or replace the candidate with a source whose compatible license is evidenced before capture or transformation.

review_policy.authority: Verify the publisher, publication channel, date, and current status at the canonical locator.
review_policy.rights: Record source-specific permission for storage, transformation, embedding, excerpt display, commercial use, and bounded provider transmission; public availability alone is insufficient.
review_policy.clinical: A named clinician must approve the exact case and variant coverage claims, exclusions, urgency implications, and section boundaries.
review_policy.language_and_readability: A named native Simplified-Chinese reviewer must approve patient-facing wording after any transformation.
review_policy.retrieval: Only approved sections may enter a candidate release; the frozen retrieval and complete-answer gates must then be rerun before activation.

coverage_snapshot.interpretation: Link-only source candidates are research leads, not eligible evidence or approved clinical support.
